method.scope: Offline research only, both real pullbacks submitted immediately after original confirmation. No 15min delayed market entry. Same original SL; each entry closer to SL than reference. Two limit orders; either may remain unfilled. Expiry from confirmation; cancel pending at its planned TP/SL/deadline. Fixed setup risk split, not lot split. No BE/trailing/early close.
method.units: body fractions multiply final confirmation body; reference-risk fractions multiply original reference-to-SL distance. BUY subtracts distance, SELL adds it.
method.targetModes: Common original-reference target is reference +/-1.25 original risk; actual per-entry RR is higher. Exact-per-entry mode sets each target at entry +/-1.25 its own stop distance. Independent target cancellation inherited from path engine; if price is already beyond an entry target at order inception that entry is retired.
method.sizing: Assume100oz gold, .01 min/step, floor lots. If either entry cannot fit allocated budget, skip whole setup; never use second-only fallback. Fixed total $50 allowance, ideal model versus strict two-order size/cost sensitivity.
method.costs: Illustrative total round-trip price cost .20/.50 gold units plus $7/lot. Not observed broker fees or executable bid/ask. SL risk allocation excludes costs/slippage; no margin/daily/concurrent-risk model.
method.limitations: All historical dates reused. Hindsight winners labeled; no independent validation. Historical replay M15, former fresh Nov18-20 M1. Unknown outcomes excluded; DD known resolved cash only, excludes floating losses. Two orders do not guarantee two fills.
